summary: Add tenant-scoped cancellation, return, inspection and refund-allocation aggregates with idempotent API mutations and explicit unknown refund outcomes.

impacts.evidence: All new aggregates, histories and evidence carry organization/workspace keys and forced RLS.
Evidence is bounded and excludes raw provider payloads and unnecessary customer data.
Existing payment refund route remains compatible; additive returns/cancellations routes are documented in OpenAPI.
Four versioned canonical event payloads are catalogued and fixture-validated.
Remote work remains behind existing connector capability boundaries; no provider branch enters core.
Migration 29 is additive, transactional, checksummed, tenant constrained and backup-gated.
New routes require tenant permissions; credentials and raw remote responses are not persisted.
Sensitive and legally significant mutations retain Task-017 approval/policy ownership.
State changes and allocations append sanitized audit records with correlation IDs.
Aggregate idempotency keys, optimistic versions and explicit unknown refund states prevent blind retries.
Future remote execution must use existing host-mediated connector and webhook boundaries.
Status indexes and bounded evidence support operational reconciliation; live SLO qualification remains pending.
Additive tables can be disabled at route/policy level and migration does not rewrite historical facts.
Core, repository static, API parity and contract fixture tests cover the new surface.
